title: Three fixed points on the symplectic quadric threefold

abstractEnglish: We construct a smooth Hamiltonian diffeomorphism of the complex quadric threefold with exactly three fixed points, at least one of which is degenerate. The critical number and the unit-inclusive rational cup length of this manifold are both four. Thus the example disproves the unrestricted critical-number and rational cup-length forms of the Arnold conjecture.
